nodes.label: L'essaim qui passe la frontière (traité fictif entre Valmiel et Hohenruche, 1410)
Treaty of 1410 between Valmiel and Hohenruche
nodes.rationale: Fictional 1410 treaty: a swarm that crosses from Valmiel to Hohenruche stays its owner's if claimed within three days by striking the cauldron at the boundary stone; after that it belongs to Hohenruche. It is the only treaty that names the cauldron in two customs.
nodes.evidence: Le traité de 1410 dit qu'un essaim passé de Valmiel à Hohenruche reste à son maître s'il le réclame dans les trois jours

nodes.label: Swarm pursuit right
nodes.rationale: The owner keeps the swarm if claimed within three days; past that deadline the swarm belongs to Hohenruche.
nodes.evidence: Passé ce délai, l'essaim est à Hohenruche.

nodes.label: Three-day claim period
nodes.rationale: The claim must be made within three days of the swarm crossing.
nodes.evidence: reste à son maître s'il le réclame dans les trois jours

nodes.label: Cauldron striking
nodes.rationale: The claim is made by striking the cauldron at the boundary stone; the 1410 treaty is the only one naming the cauldron in two customs.
nodes.evidence: en frappant le chaudron à la borne
